dialog: Look at me/ Yuuka! I'm giving it my all!
I'm a stage 3 boss/ you know!
You kids need to be taught a lesson!
You're gonna regret picking a fight with me!
Losing sucks/ so I'm fighting back!
It's time put up or shut up!
Tough times are where I shine!
I'll toss you/ so... make sure you come back to momma/ okay?
This scythe was tailor-made for me!
I'll whet my scythe on you!
Floor tiles can't talk. Definitely. For suresies.
I'll dice you into thirds/ with...!
How's this for a killer move?!
I don't know the MEANING of missing!
I'm actually pretty good at hide-and-seek!
Wait/ where'd that even come from?
I'm pressing a button to pay my respects!
Your attack won't be in vain!
If there's a chance to win/ I'll take it!
Wassup/ it's ya girl Elly here!
Homework need finishing? I'll get it done!
Protecting people is my life's work!
You won't die. I'll protect you.\n　...Damn I'm cool.
I'll mow down any fools who get in our way!\n　...Like a boss.
I'll make some space for you!
Aw yeah/ I'm really feeling it!
Here's our chance for the W!
Meiling! If even you aren't sturdy enough/ I'll have to go on the offense!
I'm a gatekeeper too/ you know!
I guess even you need someone watching your back sometimes!
We practiced this timing in front of the gate!
Let's take this one down/ Meiling!
Try not to hit me from back there!
Well... I gotta be mad/ since Yuuka'd be mad here.
C'mon Blondie/ put your back in it!
Why does Yuuka like you when you're this weak?
I gotta distinguish myself from you blonde-haired bimbos!
I can't let a blonde get the credit!
I'll match your timing/ just this once!
Let's turn up the heat/ Blondie!
I can't believe Kurumi had to cover for me...
You can do better than that/ Kurumi!
You're a bit of a pushover/ Kurumi.
I won't let you beat up Kurumi!
C'mon/ we gotta earn Yuuka's praise somehow.
Two-for-one special!\n　...Wait/ that means we only get half each!
Try not to hit me from back there!
Kurumi and I are unstoppable together!
Let's take this one down/ Kurumi!
I'd be worried if I left it all to you/ Kurumi!
Please god/ don't let me hit Yuuka accidentally...
Yuuka and I are unstoppable together!
We're going after this one? You're the boss!
With Yuuka here/ no hurdle is too high!
Please don't blow me up too/ Yuuka!
Here's me and Yuuka's SUPER COMBO ATTACK!
I am the rocks of the eternal shore!
My feelings for Yuuka are unbreakable!
You hit me? Wow/ great job!
Hah! You've got a ways to go/ kiddo.
You can try a little harder/ if you want.
I'm like/ totally freaking out here!
Things are looking a little dicey for ol' Elly here...
Man/ it wasn't supposed to be like this...
I'm just giving you a fair chance/ that's all!
I'm plenty good at my job!
If I can't dodge it/ then I'll just block it!
Psh! You don't hold a candle to Yuuka's lasers!
I can handle a little rough-housing!
I'm not one to be discouraged!
Whoa! Almost lost my hat there...
Check it/ this is my power!
Taking it slow? Then I'll go first!
Sorry gang/ I'll head back first.
Sorry gang/ I'll head back first.
I was supposed to show off how badass I am here...
I sense the aura of a kindred spirit...
I've got you beat by two whole stages!
Who cares if you're a god? Not me!
I don't care how hot you are/ I'll cooler than an icecube in winter!
Don't worry Okuu/ I'll smack some sense into you!
This girl just wants to have fun!
Dang/ you've got great taste in clothes.
I ain't afraid of no lightning!
Look out girls/ we've got a real big-shot over here!
You're tough/ but not as tough as me!
You're not getting away with this!
Do you know how hard it's gonna be to clean up after this?!
Yuuka! Hey! Hi! Hello! I'm here!!
I've missed being bullied by you...
Okay Yuuka! For you/ I'm actually going to take this seriously!
I'm part of the gang too/ now!
You're being SUPER reckless right now!
Feels like I'm taking Old Sheepie out backside of the barn/ here.
I'm not gonna lose to a sleepyhead like you!
My scythe'll take care of you lickety-split!
I've had enough of your nightmares/ thanks!
I'm not gonna lose to a sleepyhead like you!
My scythe'll take care of you lickety-split!
